narrative:
Capex is about GBP 31M a year (4.8% of revenue):

• Product development — capitalised software for PhoneLine+ and Horizon GBP 10M
• Network & data centre capacity GBP 9M
• IT, billing & data platforms (SQL Server → Snowflake) GBP 5M
• Customer premises equipment GBP 4M; Germany integration platforms GBP 3M

Capex is low relative to EBITDA, so Gamma converts most of its EBITDA into free cash flow — a key point for the new owner.
